confidence: medium — 1980/1983 totals exclude BPS rows not printed in those volumes; 1999/2001 books are Volume II only so care lane is schools-only (cage lane complete). Direction of the 1991-1995 ratio jump is robust to fire-inclusion sensitivity and is driven by Schools+Health appropriations roughly doubling while Police/Sheriff grew more slowly.
falsifier: If the missing Parks/Library/Health rows from other volumes of the FY99/FY01 sets add >=60% to the care lane, the 1999/2001 ratios would fall back toward the pre-1990 band and the flip would be an artifact of volume coverage rather than budget composition. A parallel check from the FY93/FY94 books (gold) already shows Parks+Library at ~27M on a ~220M care lane (~12%), so a >=5x care-lane expansion from missing volumes is implausible — but the check is stated so the conclusion can be killed cleanly.
data_caveats: 1980/1983: BPS appropriation not separable in those volumes
1999/2001: single-volume (II) coverage; care lane = BPS only
FY94 sheriff drop reflects state jail takeover (basis break between 1993 and 1994 cage lanes)
